name: incidencias-fes
description: Sistema de incidencias de infraestructura (React + Express + PostgreSQL)

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.test: npm --prefix server test && npm --prefix client test
